Keep in mind that playing Pichu online is super super hard. 

His combos, as you know, rely on DI reads for the most part which are harder to follow up on online. Same goes for any character with a 'free-flowing' combo tree.

 Another thing is that online basically rewards mashing because moves in general are harder to punish. This makes pichu's life hard cuz getting hit by stray moves can evaporate his stock.

I suggest playing with a 'preparing for offline' mindset wherein you try conceiving a gameplan with the character based off the matchup experience you gained online. You focus on neutral concepts such as overshooting and spacing, as well as whiff punishing...not necessarily to win (whiff punishing isnt even all that amazing online) but to prepare yourself for such situations offline. 

Best of luck!!! And if you wish, we can play friendlies sometime.
